import hashlib, json, runpy
from pathlib import Path
OUT=Path(__file__).parent
ROOT=OUT.parent.parent
files=[p for folder in (ROOT/'inputs', OUT.parent/'base') for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_file()]
hashes={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
(OUT/'source_hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
runpy.run_path(str(OUT/'allocate.py'),run_name='__main__')
